audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2-5 each contradict their own explanation and the packet chart. whys[2] and whys[4] call Level 3 and Level 6 even while the rows say Ziggs; whys[3] and whys[5] give Levels 4-5 and First item to Ziggs while the rows say Skill.
audit.why: No mirror exists yet, so this page is the reference the ziggs__yorick audit will be written against — it has to agree with itself first.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 and 4 -> Skill at 5/10, rows 3 and 5 -> Ziggs at 3/10, as matched full/content pairs in one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The lane-defining cooldowns were never given a number anywhere on the page, so 'engage when Satchel is down' has no duration attached.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 1000 range on 20/18/16/14/12s — the same timer as your own Dark Procession, which is what makes the trade of cooldowns even. Bouncing Bomb is 850 range on 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s and Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[2].d now carry those numbers, with the cage-for-Satchel trade stated explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ziggs' W and E are swapped across the page: spikes[0].text calls the minefield '(W)' and Satchel '(E)', wants.foe[1] calls Satchel '(E)', and content.early plus wants.foe[0] call the mines 'W mines'. The Short Fuse auto-reset tell is absent entirely.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is W (1000 range, 20/18/16/14/12s, knocks both of you away); Hexplosive Minefield is E (900 range, flat 16s, slowing proximity mines). Short Fuse is the passive: a periodic empowered auto whose cooldown drops every time he casts, so his poke ends in an auto more often than players expect.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected in all four fields, and dontsFull[0].d now states the Short Fuse reset as the wind-up cue.

edits.before: Ziggs pokes you off the wave with Bouncing Bomb (Q) and zones your minions and ghouls with Hexplosive Minefield (W); every time you walk up to Q a caster he chunks you for free. Bring sustain and use E Mourning Mist to close — but his Satchel Charge (E) knockback stops your all-in cold. Farm with ghouls at range and don't get poked to death.
edits.after: Ziggs pokes you off the wave with Bouncing Bomb (Q), 850 range on 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, and zones your minions and ghouls with Hexplosive Minefield (E) on a flat 16s; every walk-up costs you health. Satchel Charge (W) then knocks you away on 20/18/16/14/12s to break the all-in. Farm behind ghouls and don't get poked to death.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are Ziggs' — his Q out-ranges you and W mines zone your approach and your ghouls. Don't try to trade into the poke; last-hit carefully with ghoul help and accept you'll take some chip.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are Ziggs' — his 850-range Q out-ranges you and his E mines zone your approach and your ghouls. Don't trade into the poke; last-hit carefully with ghoul help and accept that you'll take chip.

edits.before: Zone the wave with W mines and chunk you with Q
edits.after: Zone the wave with E mines and chunk you with Q

edits.before: Knock you back with Satchel Charge (E) to deny all-ins
edits.after: Knock you back with Satchel Charge (W) to deny all-ins

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Satchel Charge is 1000 range on 20/18/16/14/12s and throws you both — engage once it's spent.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Ziggs so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Last Rites digs a grave on every champion hit — bank three or four of them before you walk inside his 850-range Q.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Your 20s cage answers his 20s Satchel — spend them one for one.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Short Fuse is an auto reset his casts refresh — watch for that wind-up.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A cage spent on poke leaves 20 seconds with no answer to Satchel.

edits.before: Trading without ghouls or caging nothing — Yorick without the swarm is the worst duelist in the lane.
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s slow zone — send the swarm in only once it is spent.

notes: The kit file tags Satchel Charge with percentHealth, but Riot's description says only magic damage plus a knock-away, so I did not write any max-health claim into the itemisation advice. No mirror exists for this matchup yet — this page sets the sides ziggs__yorick must invert.
